title: Estimator work formula
statement: Let $n,m\in\mathbb N$, let $J$ be a finite set of coordinates among the $n$ coordinates, and let $S\subseteq J$. The work component of the restricted Fourier weight estimator cost is $3mn+m(2+(2n+2|S|+1))+(m+1)$.
hypotheses_covered: finite coordinate set J within the n coordinates
